name: FullHunt attack-surface API (fullhunt.io)
tier_rationale: Commercial attack-surface platform with public API documentation, published rate limits and terms; council P007 cond 1 classes FullHunt community (A8).

reliability.justification: Attack-surface index; community accounts get limited results per query (metadata all_results_count vs hosts returned).

fullhunt.plan_hint: business = a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (never an analyst's personal free account, P007 cond 3); key_plans.fullhunt='business' unlocks it under the corporate profile

subdomains.title: FullHunt domain subdomains (GET /api/v1/domain/{domain}/subdomains)

terms.quote: P007 cond 3 (binding council text): key-terms per adapter - a company/team account, never an analyst's personal free account, on a plan whose terms permit internal business use; legal records the plan and the terms URL in the registry before the adapter runs under the corporate profile (A1).

subdomains.notes: Research C0029 (verified_needs_key: 401 {"message":"Unauthorized access"} without key; real fixture). Documented error schema {status, message}; 403 = the plan lacks the capability; 429 {"error":"Rate Limit Exceeded"} with X-RateLimit-* headers; the subdomains route allows 200 requests/hour (quota block) on top of monthly credits. Never call scan-triggering enterprise or on-demand endpoints. Used by subdomains_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-1 (P007, module subdomains_keyed). The legacy KNOWN_KEYS entry 'fullhunt' (FULLHUNT_API_KEY) is merged with this key block.
